@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8e80'
+title: Change feed with no filter hides tombstones, the same as a task list
+---
+## What
+`Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Observe/ChangeFilter.swift:57-59`: with no filter, the code returns `{ _ in true }` before `TaskFilter` runs. Thus the "hidden unless named" rule (only `DELETED` is hidden, plan.md line 156, §6.7) does not apply to `history` and `Subscription.changes`. A task list with no filter hides a tombstone, but the feed shows its updates.
+
+Decision for this task (consistent with the rule at plan.md line 156): the feed applies the same rule. A task update whose node is a tombstone after the change matches only a filter that names `#DELETED`, `^<id>`, or `~task`. The update of the delete itself (the change from live to tombstone) stays in the feed with no filter, so that a client sees the delete. If the owner wants a different rule, change it here.
+
+- Run the no-filter case through the same `TaskFilter` path.
+- Update plan.md §6.7 with the exact rule for the delete update.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `history` with no filter shows the delete of a task, but not later updates of the tombstone (for example a derived change).
+- [ ] `history(filter:"#DELETED")` shows all updates of tombstones.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests in `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Observe/` (`ChangeFilterTests.swift` or the history tests).
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
